newsitem.title: USA: CERBCO to exit copier business for $22 mln.
newsitem.headline: CERBCO to exit copier business for $22 mln.

text.p: CERBCO Inc said it entered into a definitive agreement with Capitol Office Solutions Inc in which Capitol Office will redeem the two-thirds stake in Capitol Office held by CERBERONICS Inc, a wholly owned subsidiary of CERBCO, for approximately $19 million.
CERBCO will also receive a two-thirds share of an approximate $5 million pre-redemption dividend of excess cash to be disbursed prior to the closing.
CERBERONICS will receive approximately $22 million from the redemption and dividend which would represent a pretax gain of approximately $10 per share to CERBCO.

CERBCO is a holding company which through its subsidiary, CERBERONICS Inc, has a controlling interest in Insituform East Inc, which rehabilitates sewers and pipelines, and Capitol Office, which services and supplies copier and fax equipment.
